cd /workspace && rm -f tmp/lookup-*; for f in tmp/scale64.json tmp/scale_maxruns.json tmp/scale_full.json tmp/semantic.json tmp/eight.json; do echo "== $f"; python3 -c "
import json,sys,random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from goldrun import run
import light
payload=open('$f','rb').read()
out=run(payload)
req=json.loads(payload)

import json,sys,random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from goldrun import run
from verify import verify
for f in ['tmp/semantic.json','tmp/eight.json']:
    payload=open('/workspace/'+f,'rb').read()
    out=run(payload); verify(json.loads(payload),out,random.Random(5)); print('VERIFIED',f)
"
